services.name: Teacher Training
services.desc: Whether you’re looking to start a new career or to deepen your knowledge and Pilates practice, our instructor training program offers valuable knowledge that will enrich your understanding of the human body and prepare you for a successful career. The Pilates O Ka Lā Instructor Certification Program is designed for those wanting to become Pilates Instructors, but also students who are simply interested in deepening their Pilates practice. The program is broken down into 2 sections: Mat and Equipment. In order to become an instructor you must complete both programs.
